charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 during work hours, but on day 14 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:30. The charger is at coffee_table_l1 during the morning (09:00-10:00). Check coffee_table_l1 for morning queries and desk_o1 for mid-day (10:00-17:00).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but on day 14 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 08:54, 09:36, and 13:19. The bottle is at coffee_table_l1 during the morning and early afternoon. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-10:00) and early afternoon (13:00-14:00), and desk_o1 for late afternoon (14:00-17:00).

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but on day 14 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:41, 12:40, 13:22, 14:02, and 16:24. The mug is consistently at coffee_table_l1 throughout the day. Check coffee_table_l1 for all daytime queries (08:00-18:00).

book_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1, but on day 14 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 08:54. The book is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning queries.

glass_tomas: No new errors today; keep previous pattern of dining_table_d1 for early evening and nightstand_b1 for very late night.
